checker.takeaway: Cooper, a cat, has reduced intake with about 50 h since his last fully eaten meal, which is inside the hepatic-lipidosis risk window. He is on an owner-entered venison diet trial, day 19 of 42.
omissions: Vomiting is not mentioned: 4 entries on 4 of 22 logged days, the last on Oct 13. This is concurrent in a cat with falling intake and is relevant to the lipidosis risk and to the trial.

The confounder line says no medication or supplement is recorded but it was not checked with the owner. The summary also gives no adherence or off-list exposure information for the trial.
